trends.whatProductOffers: A whole-life annuity bought with a one-time premium that pays monthly income for the whole Income Period, starting from the 1st monthiversary with a 0-year accumulation period or the 61st monthiversary with a 5-year accumulation period.
exclusionsOrConditions: Monthly income comprises guaranteed monthly income, non-guaranteed monthly income (which may be zero) and any extra income.
Guaranteed monthly income is payable from the first guaranteed payment date to the end of the Income Period; non-guaranteed income is credited at the company's discretion.
Issue age is restricted to 40-75, so younger clients cannot apply.
Premium amounts and the income rate are not published on the product page.
clientSignalPhrases: has a lump sum to convert
clientProfileFit: Retirees aged 40-75 with a lump sum
